subject: Pilot cadence & access windows for console + API walkthrough
messages:
From: Jared Li <support@acme-payments.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot prep — console walkthrough + API enablement (next week)

Hi Evelyn / Camila,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. We're ready to run a short pilot next week focused on a console walkthrough for our SREs and a separate API enablement session for our payments engineering team. Goal is to validate the integration flow and quota/latency expectations before we commit to Dedicated capacity.

Constraints: Tom (our infra lead) is only available mornings PST; our PM Jared (me) can do afternoons PST. Ideally we land two 60-min sessions on different days.

Can you propose a few windows and tell us what access you need ahead of time (console accounts, API keys, sample dataset)? We have a strict maintenance window on 9/2 that would block a morning slot.

Also, please share any short runbook or checklist we should review beforehand.

Thanks,
Jared Li
Technical Program Manager | Acme Payments
support@acme-payments.com

Attachments: pilot-runbook.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)

Notes / asks from me:
- We should offer at least three candidate windows across two days (one morning for Tom, one afternoon for Jared).
- Share the trimmed runbook and an access checklist (I'll attach a lightweight checklist).
- Decide who owns the API deep-dive: Camila (API lead) + Ben as backup for rate-limit/throughput discussion.

I can take the booking with them once we agree slots. Keep replies short — I'll consolidate and send.

Evelyn Hart

Hi Jared / Tom — thanks for the details. Proposed windows below (all sessions are 60 minutes). Please indicate preferences / conflicts and who should be invited on the Redwood side for each session.

Option A
- Console walkthrough (SREs): Tue 2026-09-01 09:00–10:00 PT (morning for Tom)
- API enablement (eng): Wed 2026-09-02 14:00–15:00 PT (afternoon for Jared)

Option B
- Console walkthrough: Mon 2026-08-31 10:00–11:00 PT
- API enablement: Tue 2026-09-01 15:00–16:00 PT

Option C (compressed week)
- Console walkthrough: Mon 2026-08-31 08:30–09:30 PT
- API enablement: Mon 2026-08-31 13:00–14:00 PT

Pre-reqs we need from Acme before the sessions:
- List of SRE accounts (emails) to add to the console with role hints
- IP ranges for any network allowlists (if you have them)
- A sample API key or a request to provision a sandbox key (we can create a short-lived sandbox key)
- Any high-priority test flows you want us to exercise (e.g., batch ingestion or low-latency single request)

Attachments: access-checklist.xlsx, pilot-runbook.pdf

Let us know which option works and who to calendar. Camila will lead the API session; Ben will join the console discussion for observability and quota questions. If you prefer, we can collapse into a single half-day block but recommend separate sessions to keep SRE/eng topics focused.

Best,
Evelyn
